html:
On 7 July 2021 President Jovenel Moise of Haiti was shot dead in his home near Port-au-Prince by a squad of gunmen, most of them former Colombian soldiers. His wife was wounded.

Moise had ruled by decree after elections were not held, and protests against him had been large. The plot was tied to Haitian and foreign figures, and trials were held in the United States.

After his death no elected official was left in national office. Armed gangs took control of most of Port-au-Prince, and millions faced hunger. In 2024 a Kenyan led police mission backed by the UN arrived to fight the gangs, in a country still marked by the earthquake and by the foreign interventions of the past.
sum: On 7 July 2021 President Jovenel Moise of Haiti was shot dead in his home near Port-au-Prince by a squad of gunmen, most of them former Colombian soldiers. His wife was wounded.
